A young woman marries the love of her life, only to face constant challenges as her disapproving mother-in-law makes her new life anything but easy.
Two children narrate the story of Lord Vishnu and his ten incarnations who have constantly fought and emerged victorious over any evil that may exist.

Mohan seeks permission from Shobha to visit a venue for occupational duties. However, she consents solely on the stipulation that he completes every domestic task first.
Bhanumati puts on the outfit tailored by Mohan for a customer. However, as he plans to add further embellishments to the garment, his mother-in-law arrives and underestimates his skills.
Anjali discovers Shobha's strand inside a vessel of dairy and immediately berates her. Subsequently, she instructs Shobha to groom her hair neatly.
Despite Mohan suffering from dental pain, Shobha instructs him to press her mother's garment. Meanwhile, Bhanumati offers Mohan a spice bud to ease his discomfort.
Bhanumati compels Mohan to begin a fitness routine. However, Mohan's mother-in-law arrives during their workout and grows suspicious, mistaking their posture for an embrace.
Bhanumati warns Mohan that Sameer faces grave trouble if their wedding proceeds. Consequently, she urges him to halt the preparations immediately.
Mohan, a modest tailor, endures torment from his domineering spouse and mother-in-law. Consequently, a fairy assists him, transforming his daily existence.
Mohan frets over his friend Sameer and repeatedly recalls their past conversations. Later, he informs Bhanumati that Sameer remains unaware of his transformation into an insect.
Mohan reveals his insect metamorphosis to Sameer, who dismisses the claim. Meanwhile, Sameer enquires about Bhanumati and abruptly fears she may have taken her own life.
Mohan plans to delight Shobha by presenting her with a kitchen appliance. However, Shobha unexpectedly appears and instructs him to finish his tasks.

Bhanumati witnesses Sameer expelling his nephew, Manya, from the residence. Later, she approaches Manya and urges him to confide his troubles in her.
Shobha's mother familiarises her with her old friend, Ruhini. However, as she attempts to present Ruhini to Mohan, Bhanumati casts a spell that renders the woman mute.
